name: Ellen Smith, Appellant v. Robert Jones and Jones Hauling, LLC

opinions.text:
This hand-made record stands in for a CourtListener case in stare's tests. Its text, names and docket are invented.

The question is whether a hauler's written estimate is an offer. We have held that a residence, not a mailing address, is the test of domicile. D'Elia & Marks Co. v. Lyon, 31 A.2d 647 (D.C. Mun. Ct. App. 1943).

The order of the Superior Court is affirmed.
opinions.author: Saylor

opinions.text: I respectfully dissent. An estimate invites an offer; it does not make one.
opinions.author: Wecht
